title: Polished Breakout
prompt: Build a polished browser Breakout game with responsive layout, paddle controls, ball physics, brick grid, score, lives, win/lose states, restart, and clear visual feedback. The result must run locally without paid services.
acceptanceCriteria: Paddle input works with keyboard, pointer, and touch where practical.
Ball, wall, paddle, and brick collisions feel consistent and fair.
Score, lives, win, lose, and restart states are visible and correct.
Game scales cleanly across mobile and desktop sizes.
Visual styling, motion, and feedback make the game easy to judge from a preview.
Project includes run instructions and at least one automated or scripted sanity check.
requiredArtifacts: preview URL or local run command
